definitions: To open something, often with a slight break or crack, or to begin to open something.
To reveal or make accessible something previously hidden or difficult to access.
To open a beverage container, especially a beer or soda can/bottle.
examples: He cracked open the book to the first page.
The detective cracked open the cold case.
They cracked open a couple of cold ones after work.
pastTenses: cracked open (simple past), cracked open (past perfect)
